answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 2024 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Can we perform Umrah in other people's name who is muslim and alive and who can perform his own umrah at later time? Question: Can we perform Umrah in other people's name who is muslim and alive and who can perform his own umrah at later time? Answer ID: 2024 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 518/518=L) Yes, you can perform Umrah and can convey the reward to Muslims who are alive and can perform their Umrah later: الأصل فی ھذا الباب أن الانسان لہ أن یجعل ثواب عملہ لغیرہ صلاۃ أو صوماً أو صدقۃ الی أن قال و فی الحج النفل تجوز الانابۃ حالۃ القدرۃ لأن باب النفل أوسع (ھدایہ: 1/296) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
